entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that functions as a universal memory layer with support for multi-level User, Session, and Agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, self-hosted server, or an Apache-2.0 open-source SDK.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This agent memory system focuses on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows that allow agents to learn over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or as a managed cloud service using Python and Node.js client libraries.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system. This AGPL-3.0 context database archives sessions as editable Markdown files and has demonstrated a 91% token reduction on LoCoMo10 benchmarks.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that runs locally on a CPU. It builds searchable graphs from text, code, and conversations while supporting custom ontologies for structured data modeling.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that sustains sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It utilizes byte-level deduplication for prompt-cache discounts and supports multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated agent brain that combines keyword retrieval, semantic search, and synthesis with citations. It exposes a typed knowledge graph to agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) over Tailscale or local connections.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that serves as the upstream foundation for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper. Implemented as a FastAPI server, it supports managed or Docker-based deployments and integrates with MCP and Cursor-compatible clients.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It employs a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to achieve sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that requires only Python 3.10 and a single SQLite database. It provides sub-millisecond performance and features episodic compression to manage storage growth at scale.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent vector search and structured facts. It includes an auto-curated wiki and a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that generates filesystem-first traces and outcome-gated context bundles to assist agents with complex tasks. It provides specific entry points for Hermes and supports various providers including OpenAI-compatible and self-hosted vLLM instances.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent that uses a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) and SQLite to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for recovering specific details from the message persistence store.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from 35 different coding agents to provide shared cross-tool memory without using models or external servers. It allows users to search months of past sessions by tracking file edits, command exit statuses, and specific session spans locally on disk.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent via an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers to maintain persistent agent state.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity and memory layer that integrates with Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI while supporting real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub. It focuses on portable state and demonstrates 97.6% answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores context as human-readable YAML engrams on local disk for use across multiple coding agents. It utilizes local-first retrieval methods, including BGE-small and optional rerankers, to manage agent context.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It captures agent decisions and preferences from session transcripts using a retrieval system that fuses BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This five-package plugin family provides durable, file-based memory using a SQLite-backed hierarchical schema and FTS5 search. The architecture is notable for requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models while supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes long-context LLM inference for Hermes Agent and OpenClaw through text and multimodal context reordering. It provides a context index for deduplication and cache-aware scheduling to preserve accuracy during prefix-cache sharing.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded in-process backend provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recall with a reason and surfacing contradictions through conflict resolution primitives. It manages memory through canonicalization, recency ranking, and automated maintenance without requiring a separate server.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers and host-specific plugins.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This machine-facing CLI allows agents to autonomously maintain persistent wiki pages, citations, and links across sessions. It supports portable memory archives, enabling agents to import and merge source-grounded knowledge as they evolve.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This MCP-native server uses anticipatory caching to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It relies on local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models to provide RAG and vector search capabilities.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack functions as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for the Hermes agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver specific evidence packets for every agent query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory for AI agents using a combination of BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, utilizing edge tags to establish navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by employing local BM25 tool ranking to select relevant schemas. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: This Git-backed layer provides durable context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex by storing information in plain Markdown. It manages reviewed context updates through a system of hash-checked proposals and receipts rather than relying on native agent memory.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via importance-weighted recall. It combines BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction for structured retrieval.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a community fix for immediate event deletion, this pull-model episodic memory plugin ensures no persistent summaries remain after removal. It features an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables budget-bound agent wallets to handle x402 payments across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It operates without a backend or API keys, allowing agents to pay for services using USDC and other stablecoins.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to facilitate capability routing. It provides five native tools for artifact retrieval and uses session hooks to inject concise system-prompt hints during agent operations.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected instances. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots, backed by a local SQLite layer for caching and write reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin offers self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and targeted searching. It enhances retrieval accuracy through configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, supporting semantic search and grounded Q&A through a required local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for file reads and synchronization.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval methods. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, offering metadata filtering and MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This project offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve agent state.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies stale information and contradictions within agent memory using specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators. It generates evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review and utilizes a local git repository to track or revert changes to plain markdown memory files.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while adhering to TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development methodology that integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime. It allows agents to export designs into various formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured security skills mapped to industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST CSF 2.0. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, covering 34 distinct security domains.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the conversion of codebases, schemas, and natural language descriptions into draw.io diagrams. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and offers both a CLI and an MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool manages natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and connector skills to facilitate escrow and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns through Rewrite, Detect, and Edit-in-place modes. It is designed for compatibility with agents such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies skill libraries across devices and teams while using an agentic evolver to automate deduplication and quality improvements. It integrates with Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenAI-compatible APIs for collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 1,176 markdown-based professional skills across 35 different vocations that run natively in Hermes Agent. The library operates without a runtime, telemetry, or the need for user accounts.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows agents to search YouTube, browse channels, extract playlists, and access video transcripts. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Cursor, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds to streamline agent capability expansion.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. It includes a reporting feature that identifies potential analysis blind spots alongside its findings.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It enables the execution of scripts and bundled resources within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host system.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files from documentation and automatically syncs source edits back to the original literate document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality control by utilizing a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for long-running agents using a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage and event logging. It coordinates agent teams via the SLP protocol and distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides a registry of Portuguese-language skills and guides for VPS deployment and MCP integration. It supports skill installation through a CLI tap or direct raw URLs.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built on the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. These developer tools are designed for installation via the Vercel CLI for open skills.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation prompting. It integrates the BFL API to manage polling, webhooks, and video generation workflows.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts code repositories and developer discourse into verified instruction files compliant with the agentskills.io spec. It includes automated workflows for briefing, testing, and exporting skills mapped to specific source lines.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that compiles natural language descriptions into readable .nika files. It features deterministic compilation, manual approval steps, and execution traces for verification.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills that can be installed via a Python client or CLI with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks with autonomous execution and real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for task recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project utilizes a five-layer retrieval system, including semantic embeddings and FTS5, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering skills through hard triggers and RRF fusion, it reduces token usage while maintaining graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client uses a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token consumption during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata discovery to validate the agentskills.io pattern.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes to drive scheduling and system design. It stores all data in a local SQLite file and provides interfaces through both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill employs three parallel subagents to conduct adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings triaged in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes Hermes Agent interactions by rewriting and scoring prompts across various interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It supports 97 languages and claims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite based on five quality dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across multiple programming languages. It features a risk-tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and reproduction within Hermes. It utilizes multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates and a Python goal engine for state management.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 industry frameworks, such as MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure of agent capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection of production-tested skills provides Hermes with commands for session tracking, worktree recovery, and PR orchestration. The skills are installed as drop-in markdown files and include a bundled installer for managing updates and drift checks.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent, tracking token costs, session history, and skill analytics. It ensures data privacy through local log desensitization and read-only access, with optional incident alerting via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal CLIs, web apps, and libraries, optimizing output files to remain under an 8 MB target size.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify skill gaps and propose structured updates. It gates these improvements behind an evaluation framework using deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators without requiring external services.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills files while monitoring official specifications to prevent field drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides skills for social data enrichment, CRM management, and lead generation across platforms like Claude Code and Cursor. It includes a workspace Postgres database and an MCP server to handle browser-based OAuth authentication.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for video-to-text transcription, OCR via macOS Vision, and e-commerce material generation. It features a rule-based engine designed to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from generated text.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards for programmatic financial transactions.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides functional quality certification by testing agent skills for structure, security, and functionality within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill's operational integrity.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables agents to earn or distribute USDC payments on the Base network by facilitating support bounties over x402. It allows users to list bounties and buy context without accounts or API keys, using dedicated wallet keys and price ceilings.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project integrates Scavio's hosted MCP server to provide structured web data from 31 different platforms. It exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills to Hermes, Claude, and other compatible agents.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and produces structured briefs that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework decomposes financial trading into specialized analyst, researcher, and trader roles for targeted task execution. It integrates data from SEC EDGAR, FRED, and social sentiment sources, utilizing a portfolio manager to provide final approval or rejection for all transactions.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and memory browsing while tracking operational costs. It supports local Node.js or Docker deployment and offers multiple interfaces including a Web UI, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities. It ensures persistent execution via tmux and provides sandboxing options through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams, this template utilizes a level-based architecture. It employs a task bus pattern for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live reasoning streams. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure roles using a strict pipeline architecture. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of tasks throughout the entire system.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the Hermes Kanban. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for tool handling and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution and learning, visualized through a real-time task and scoreboard dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama. It leverages Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, specifically optimized for consumer RTX 4080 and 5080 hardware.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent through automated background indexing. It auto-configures as an MCP server to provide pre-indexed project context without external processing.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token usage across Hermes Agent and other AI tools, offering a terminal UI and 3D visualization dashboard. It allows developers to monitor consumption metrics and submit data to public leaderboards and profiles.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables inspection of API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget tracks live token usage, costs, and rate limits for Hermes Agent and other CLIs with support for multi-device synchronization. It helps developers manage AI tool limits by displaying historical trends and session-specific usage details.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers compatible with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting providers. It assists in building user interfaces by providing structured architectural and design prompts.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This workflow layer adds 36 skills and 6 specialized agent roles to Hermes Agent, coordinated through a CTO loop. It automates the entire application lifecycle, from deployment on VPS or local environments to health checks and log observation.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-created themes and skins to customize the Hermes Agent terminal UI with unique ASCII art, banners, and colors. Users can create and apply diverse aesthetics, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk, using YAML-based configurations.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform enables a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable handles. It allows Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF management, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It integrates with Hermes Agent via MCP to support browser automation workflows and external client management.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that scans agent configurations and system prompts for schema mismatches, missing bounds, and contradictory directions. It supports HERM v1.1 scoring and exports findings in standard formats like SARIF and GitLab Code Quality.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It enables Hermes Agent to maintain persistent context across platforms like Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It provides automated macOS and Linux installation along with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents using project-local tools, memories, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides an automated installation process for hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transfers skills, memory archives, and SOUL.md/MEMORY.md files from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps credentials and configs into YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This project provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems via a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry. It features config-aware baselines and two monitoring modes, including zero-token passive analysis.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for online earning, this tool operates as a deterministic zero-network local runtime by default. It requires explicit approval for external writes and consequential actions through specific contracts for offers and opportunities.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This local, offline personal assistant adds voice capabilities to Hermes Agent with wake word support and adaptive turn-taking. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro without requiring API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin implements multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for Hermes. It includes a circuit breaker to maintain stability during MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux for handling configurations across multiple agents including Hermes Agent and Gemini CLI. It enables users to perform one-click switching between different API providers within a unified interface.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that facilitates autonomous multi-step tasks for Hermes Agent and other CLIs with integrated user approval and file access. The tool features built-in assistants for generating editable office documents and supports 24/7 unattended automation via cron and remote access.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web interface provides 1:1 parity with Hermes CLI features for use on web browsers and mobile devices. Built with Python and vanilla JS, it utilizes a three-panel layout to organize chat, sessions, and workspace browsing without external frameworks.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app offers guided installation and dependency resolution for Hermes Agent. It provides a graphical interface for chat, session management, and tool configuration while supporting various AI providers and local endpoints.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko-studio is a web dashboard that manages Hermes Agent sessions, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics across ten platforms including Telegram and Discord. It supports visual workflows that incorporate human approval gates and detailed token cost tracking.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task management. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated catalog for skills and MCP management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports fifteen built-in agents and provides native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access alongside native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application, built with Tauri and Rust, features a built-in kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat and memory management on both Windows and macOS.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser tabs to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It offers opt-in browser control and site-aware drafting through a session-synced chat interface.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that allows users to drive self-hosted Hermes agents via HTTPS or Tailscale. It enables real-time chat, task management, and file system browsing directly from iOS 18+ devices.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight provides a desktop workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. Users can monitor code writes and diffs in real-time while tracking token usage and latency via a runtime dashboard.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view that allows users to manage live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs directly from the terminal.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It tracks per-session token burn and estimated costs using a locally built search index that does not upload telemetry or history.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for communication with cloud-hosted agents.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox designed for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a mobile-first UI capable of spawning up to five concurrent background agent instances. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and uses dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for secure Telegram validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a built-in workflow engine and 100 tools for tasks including TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard focused on process transparency, offering real-time session activity tracking and cost analysis. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features a chat-first interface with tool approval cards and real-time SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and supports model switching. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated one-click installations and provides streaming SSE responses during chat.
